stem_en: Which of the following statement is correct regarding the process of replication in E.coli?

options_en.1: The DNA dependent DNA polymerase catalyses polymerization in one direction that is $3' \to 5'$
options_en.2: The DNA dependent RNA polymerase catalyses polymerization in one direction, that is $5' \to 3'$
options_en.3: The DNA dependent DNA polymerase catalyses polymerization in $5' \to 3'$ as well as $3' \to 5'$ direction
options_en.4: The DNA dependent DNA polymerase catalyses polymerization in $5' \to 3'$ direction

b6_reason: DNA dependent DNA polymerase, the replicating enzyme in E. coli, adds nucleotides only in the 5' to 3' direction, which is why the lagging strand is made discontinuously.
b6_note: Option 2 is also a factually true sentence on its own, since DNA dependent RNA polymerase likewise works only 5' to 3'. It is excluded because the question asks about replication rather than transcription, so option 4 is the statement that belongs to the process named. Confidence set to medium for that overlap.
